title: Other Developing Nations
attribution: World Climate Simulation materials by Climate Interactive, MIT Sloan, and the UMass Lowell Climate Change Initiative. Updated November 2025. Adapted for nested-agent experiments.
goals: Protect survival and pursue the 1.5C objective
Secure debt-free finance for adaptation and clean development
Protect forests while improving living standards
negotiating_constraints: Ambitious action requires strong wealthy-nation support
Developed nations should take responsibility for historic emissions
Funding must enable rather than prevent development
opportunities: Leapfrog fossil fuels with clean energy
Finance forest protection and reduce land degradation
climate_risks: Food insecurity, extreme heat and displacement
adaptation_notes: Goals and qualitative constraints paraphrase the briefing. Baseline commitments, numeric ceilings, finance-role restrictions, personalities and scoring are author-created experimental assumptions, NOT official prescribed positions. Source text reflects November 2025 and is not a live policy fact-check.
